houses.name: Apollo / Torsten Sløk
houses.title: The Low Unemployment Streak Nears a Record
houses.vsClause: They did not read Liquidity, Rates, Growth, Inflation, or Risk.
houses.quote: Through September 2026, the US labor market had kept unemployment below 5% for 61 straight
quotes: Through September 2026, the US labor market had kept unemployment below 5% for 61 straight months (since September 2021), putting it just three months shy of the record 64-month stretch set from 1965 to 1970, see chart below.

The bottom line is that the current expansion is on the verge of becoming the longest period of sustained labor market strength in modern US history , outlasting the late-1990s boom and every other run on record except one.
